mapper.sql: select card_id, owner_user_id, card_type, prompt, difference, collocation, confusion, own_sentence, interval_days, due_date, review_count, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from exam_verbal_card

sql.if: and ( prompt like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or difference like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or collocation like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or confusion like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or own_sentence like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
where del_flag = '0'
order by ifnull(update_time, create_time) desc, card_id desc
select count(1) from exam_verbal_daily where deck_date = #{deckDate}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into exam_verbal_daily (deck_date, card_id, sort, missed, create_time) values (#{deckDate}, #{cardId}, #{sort}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: select c.card_id, c.owner_user_id, c.card_type, c.prompt, c.difference, c.collocation, c.confusion, c.own_sentence, c.interval_days, c.due_date, c.review_count, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, d.missed from exam_verbal_daily d inner join exam_verbal_card c on c.card_id = d.card_id where d.deck_date = #{deckDate} and c.del_flag = '0' order by d.sort asc, d.card_id asc
mapper.update: update exam_verbal_card set card_type = #{cardType}, prompt = #{prompt}, difference = #{difference}, collocation = #{collocation}, confusion = #{confusion}, own_sentence = #{ownSentence}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where card_id = #{cardId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0'
update exam_verbal_card set interval_days = #{intervalDays}, due_date = #{dueDate}, review_count = #{reviewCount}, update_time = sysdate() where card_id = #{cardId} and del_flag = '0'
